BiblicalUsage: Moses blesses Levi: they shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and they shall put incense before thee. One verse carries the word — perfume rising before God as the priests teach his law.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Levi's charge was to put incense before God, and prayer still rises where the tribe once stood.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
